concept.literalSynthesis: A musket carrying the Jester's Star identity, loaded with fallen stars; each shot is a star that leaves a second, smaller star in its wake when it hits.
concept.coreMechanic: Fire one ranged musket shot every 32 ticks (about 0.53 seconds), consuming one fallen-star ammo unit through Terraria's native ammo system. The 31-damage gravity-arc projectile can hit once; on an actual NPC hit it creates one 12-damage star that starts along the shot direction and homes slowly. The root's speed is authored at 33.75 blocks/s, matching the source projectile's 9 pixels per tick at one update per tick, while the gravity arc and homing follow-up are explicitly authored here. This keeps the musket's observed 31 base damage, 5.25 knockback and 32-tick tempo, while making fallen stars a required recurring input instead of granting a reusable no-ammo shot. The follow-up adds damage only on a successful hit, so total combat output is greater than the musket's base shot; the one-hit root and one-child event keep that addition bounded. The fallen star is an observed ammo item, not a standalone weapon, and its source damage sentinel is not treated as attack damage.
concept.parentAContribution: The Jester's Star Musket contributes the musket identity and the observed ranged 31 damage, 5.25 knockback, shoot style, and 32-tick use interval. Its source program has a piercing star-arrow projectile and uses fallen-star ammo; this design authors a gravity arc and hit-triggered child explicitly rather than claiming those as observed abilities.
concept.parentBContribution: The Fallen Star contributes the exact fallen_star ammo category and a consumable-star identity. Its native ammo use is made an explicit requirement for every primary projectile; its source damage of -1 is an item sentinel, not weapon damage.
concept.playerExperience: Aim and fire the visible musket at the usual cadence. Each accepted shot spends one fallen star. A direct hit produces one slower homing star, so misses do not create the follow-up and the weapon has no free fallback shot.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Aim at a target and fire one gravity-curving musket projectile, spending one fallen-star ammo unit; on an NPC hit, release one slowly homing child star.

realization.description: Aim and fire the Jester's Fallen-Star Musket. Each accepted shot consumes one fallen star and launches a 31-damage ranged projectile with a downward-curving arc. If it hits an NPC, it creates one smaller 12-damage star at the impact that moves forward and homes slowly for up to 2.5 seconds. The follow-up occurs only on an actual NPC hit; it can still expire or collide with terrain before finding another target.
realization.playerExperience: The source musket's 32-tick firing interval is retained. Fallen stars are the required ammo, so keep a supply on hand; the secondary star rewards a direct hit without adding another input.
realization.selfEvaluation: The main shot explicitly owns its gravity movement, and the separate child owns slow homing. Native fallen-star ammo selection and consumption apply to the active primary spawn.
